subject.title: fix(gateway): validate webhook sessionKey template rendering

question: Should webhook sessionKey hardening add a new fail-closed character policy for externally supplied keys, and which existing static session-key shapes must remain supported?
rationale: This PR changes a security-sensitive routing selector and existing session-key compatibility, so the permanent policy should be maintainer-confirmed before accepting a contributor patch.

options.title: Require scoped fail-closed validation
options.body: Validate only externally supplied request or templated mapping keys, reject invalid values with a 400/no dispatch, and preserve static operator-owned keys.

options.title: Keep prefix-only policy
options.body: Decline the character allowlist for now and rely on `allowRequestSessionKey` plus `allowedSessionKeyPrefixes` until a broader session-key policy is designed.

options.title: Accept fallback behavior intentionally
options.body: Allow invalid rendered keys to fall back to default/generated sessions, but document and test that security tradeoff explicitly.

recommendation.title: Require scoped fail-closed validation
recommendation.body: Validate only externally supplied request or templated mapping keys, reject invalid values with a 400/no dispatch, and preserve static operator-owned keys.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior external-hook security work and hook security refactors make this the strongest routing signal.
